show: the room begins to wind down: the fire banks a little, the sitters yawn, students drift up the stair

lines.speaker: percy
text: Ten minutes, then up to bed, the lot of you!
Ten minutes! Finish what you're doing.
Ten minutes! I am a PREFECT, and I will be obeyed!
Ten minutes, and I'm counting. I'm very good at counting.

show: the room dims, the fire low, the view turns to the stair and fades, and the visit ends as leaving does

lines.speaker: percy
text: Lights out! Prefect's orders. Yes, Fred, that means you. And George.
Lights out! And the P on my jumper is NOT for 'Pompous'.
